info.title: Opc.Ua.Mcp
info.description: MCP Server exposing OPC UA Part 4 services as tools for LLM integration (Claude, Copilot, VS Code, etc.)

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: OPC UA MCP Server - Exposes OPC UA Part 4 services as MCP tools

options.name: --transport
options.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default) or 'http'. 'sse' is a deprecated alias for 'http'. [default: stdio]

options.name: --profile
options.description: Tool profiles: one profile or a comma-separated list of profiles - core, services, administration, pubsub, diagnostics, robotics, vision, or full (default). Compose profiles with ',' or '+', e.g. --profile vision,robotics for a vision-guided agent.
